cohort: 198 pregnant women at the Educational-Therapeutic Center of Shohadaye Yaftabad Referral Hospital in Tehran, Iran
finding: Sleep quality was positively correlated with FBS at 34-36 weeks and Corona Disease Anxiety, but not with other maternal or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in the type of delivery between the sleep disorders group and the no sleep disorders group.
